title: Sectorial asymptotics for centered Riemann-xi coefficients
summary: Formalizes the exact centered-xi coefficient normalization, a uniform sectorial saddle-point asymptotic, and relative-error derivative estimates through order six. These are the analytic inputs used by a two-thirds hyperbolicity-wedge theorem for Jensen polynomials of Riemann's xi-function. This Palomar topic does not itself state the final Jensen-polynomial hyperbolicity theorem.

formalizes.title: A Two-Thirds Hyperbolicity Wedge for Jensen Polynomials of Riemann's Xi-Function
